_comment: E19 systemic eval-discovery registry. Every canonical/skills/**/SKILL.md file must have an entry here (enforce-or-declare, same convention as agent_coverage.py/rule_enforcement.py): status is one of 'no_output' (router/reference/exempt -- genuinely produces nothing of its own to test), 'covered' (a real behavioral test exercises its declared output; covered_by lists the test file(s)), or 'gap' (a real declared output exists with no verified test yet -- tracked debt, not a release blocker, same ratchet core/gates/fail_open_census.py uses for its baseline). core/gates/skill_eval_coverage_census.py enforces every SKILL.md has an entry and that every 'covered' entry's test file(s) actually exist; a NEW skill file with no entry at all is what fails the gate. Re-seed additions with `py -m core.gates.skill_eval_coverage_census --update` after adding a skill.
